description: This file defines the ModelNotification class in the org.apache.ofbiz.service package. It encapsulates notification configurations including group name, event, mode, and handles notification logic such as building email contexts and invoking notification services within the OFBiz framework.

classes.name: ModelNotification
classes.description: Represents a notification model that manages notification attributes and triggers notification services based on specific events within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: getNotificationGroupName
methods.description: Returns the name of the notification group.

methods.name: callNotify
methods.description: Triggers the notification process if the event matches the specified notification event, invoking the configured service.

methods.name: buildContext
methods.description: Builds the context map used for notification delivery, gathering email parameters and relevant metadata.

methods.name: buildTo
methods.description: Constructs a comma-separated string of email addresses for the 'to' field.

methods.name: buildCc
methods.description: Constructs a comma-separated string of email addresses for the 'cc' field.

methods.name: buildBcc
methods.description: Constructs a comma-separated string of email addresses for the 'bcc' field.

methods.name: buildFrom
methods.description: Constructs a comma-separated string of email addresses for the 'from' field.

methods.name: getCommaSeparatedAddressList
methods.description: Helper method to retrieve a comma-separated string of addresses for a given notification type from a notification group.

methods.name: getAddressesByType
methods.description: Retrieves a list of addresses from a NotificationGroup for a specific notification type.

methods.name: getSubject
methods.description: Retrieves the notification subject from the associated NotificationGroup.

methods.name: getScreen
methods.description: Retrieves the notification screen URI from the associated NotificationGroup.

methods.name: getService
methods.description: Returns the service name to invoke for the notification, currently fixed to 'sendMailFromScreen'.

methods.name: getNotificationGroup
methods.description: Static method to fetch a NotificationGroup by its name.
